messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2051122334 - High request latency + rising 5xx rate on inference runtime (prod-us-west). Paging oncall @alice (severity: P1)

alice (oncall): saw it, joining. what's the current impact?

ops-bot: Alert: p95 latency 2.9s -> 3.4s over last 5m, 5xx rate 11.7% (baseline ~0.3%). Queue length on runtime pool gpu-pool-3 increased from 30 -> 480.

alice (oncall): thanks. charlie from runtime, can you confirm whether this is queuing/backpressure or upstream model slowdown?

charlie (runtime): looking. tailing logs now. seeing burst of very long-running requests (streaming sessions) + many retries from edge. KV cache hit stable. Looks like in-flight count trending to max_in_flight and the autoscaler isn't keeping up.

bob (sre): we need short mitigation to protect p95 and reduce 5xx. Options: 1) enable shedding by lowering max_in_flight on the problematic pool, 2) apply per-key rate limits for heavy customers, 3) disable streaming to reduce long-lived connections, 4) move a subset of traffic to smaller model variants. Thoughts?

alice (oncall): prioritize speed. do 3 + 1 in parallel: disable streaming for public API first (fast to toggle), and lower max_in_flight from 200 -> 80 on gpu-pool-3. Dana, can support message customers after we have noise reduced?

charlie (runtime): on it. patching runtime config now. curl shown here:```bash
# toggle streaming globally for public routes
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/configs/streaming" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/chat"], "enabled": false }'
```

charlie (runtime): applying max_in_flight change:```yaml
pool: gpu-pool-3
max_in_flight: 80
queue_limit: 100
reject_policy: shedding
timeout_ms: 30000
```

charlie (runtime): rollout started, will watch.

alice (oncall): ops-bot, start a short-lived rate-limit rule for the 95th percentile of keys (throttle bursts)

ops-bot: rate-limit rule created: scope=public-api, window=60s, burst=1200, sustained=600. Will auto-remove in 30m.

bob (sre): adding a temporary routing rule to divert 10% of traffic to fallback-small model to reduce token pressure. This is non-disruptive but will lower quality for that slice. Approving now.

charlie (runtime): diversion applied: route policy "fallback-small" -> model:redwood-small-quant; 10% traffic.

alice (oncall): monitoring dashboards — can we get 1m resolution of error rates and per-route latencies?

bob (sre): pulling dashboards. current numbers after changes (1m-aggregated): p95 latency down to 1.8s, 5xx down to 4.2%. In-flight avg down 65. Queue depth 120 -> trending down. Good early signs.

dana (support): heads-up: customers seeing streaming disabled message and a small quality change for some requests. I'm preparing a templated note for impacted customers and will open tickets for any escalations. Top affected customers (by error volume): AcmeCorp, Medlytics, PayPulse.

eve (eng-pl): how many requests were retried? we should watch for retry storms.

charlie (runtime): retries visible: a spike from a client library bug that retries on 429/500 every 200ms. We should temporarily block aggressive retries OR ask clients to backoff.

alice (oncall): set a soft 429 for noisy keys instead of hard 500s so clients back off. ops-bot can you change reject_policy for noisy keys to `rate_limit_then_429`?

ops-bot: updated policy for top offenders (identified by key hash list). Next 5m will apply.

bob (sre): checklist for now: - streaming disabled (done) - max_in_flight lowered (done) - 10% fallback routing (done) - rate limits in place (done) - reject_policy tuned for noisy keys (done) - support notified (dana)

alice (oncall): statuses: any regressions after changes?

charlie (runtime): p95 stable ~1.6s last 3m, 5xx ~2.8%. No new bucketed errors. Memory usage on nodes nominal. Autoscaler still lagging, but shedding kept latencies healthy.

dana (support): sending customer notes now. using template: "We're investigating elevated latencies; streaming temporarily disabled; quality fallback for a small fraction of requests. We'll update you when resolved."

eve (eng-pl): post-incident action items: need a permanent mitigation: better per-customer qps limits, client retry guidelines, and a streaming isolation plan (dedicated pool or token limits). Also add test harness for retry storms.

alice (oncall): agree. we'll file RFC. Charlie, can you restore streaming only after autoscaler confirms headroom and p95 < 1.5s for 10m?

charlie (runtime): yep. I'll create a canary: re-enable streaming for 1% of traffic to a canary pool with strict concurrency limits, watch 10m, then scale.

ops-bot: scheduled auto-rollback for streaming toggle in 45m if not manually cleared.

bob (sre): postmortem owners? Charlie for mitigations and autoscaler tweaks, Eve for product-level rate limits and docs, Dana for customer comms. I'll own incident write-up and timeline.

alice (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 25m, Dana is taking primary monitoring during the night. Dana, ping me if error rates >5% or p95 >2s.

dana (support): acknowledged. I'll escalate to oncall if we regress.

alice (oncall): closing live mitigation phase. Keep thread updated with any regression. Great job team. :thumbsup:
